purpose: Constrain blinded model/human approval decisions on structured qualitative relation candidates before any 2026 outcome prices are loaded.
global_approval_guards: review_state can be APPROVED only for a relation emitted by the frozen strict relation extractor
industry_or_peer_context_flag may be true only when company_attribution_flag is true and the category claim unambiguously refers to the filing company
either company_attribution_flag or high_information_document_subject_flag must be true
matched_terms must satisfy the exact frozen pattern semantics; reviewer may not infer a stronger claim than the structured relation
duplicate same-company same-category relations count once
when ambiguity remains, PENDING or REJECTED is mandatory; coverage targets are never a reason to approve

category_specific_approval.runway.multi_phase_growth_roadmap: phase relation plus plant/facility/capacity/expansion/project context is sufficient when global guards pass
category_specific_approval.runway.funding_visibility: specific funding source and capex/expansion/project linkage required
category_specific_approval.runway.physical_or_operational_headroom: physical headroom plus explicit expansion/capacity linkage required; generic land ownership rejected
category_specific_approval.runway.ramp_or_utilisation_headroom: ramp/underutilisation relation must refer to company plant/capacity/facility/line; generic industry utilisation rejected
category_specific_approval.moat.proprietary_or_ip: patent/proprietary/owned technology/know-how must be linked to company product/process/technology/capability
category_specific_approval.moat.qualification_or_regulatory_barrier: approved-vendor/qualified-supplier/customer/regulatory barrier relation required; generic ISO certification rejected
category_specific_approval.moat.customer_stickiness: repeat order/business, long-term agreement/contract, dated customer tenure, or design-in/win evidence required
category_specific_approval.moat.cost_process_or_scale_advantage: specific backward-integration/cost/process/yield/scale relation required; generic efficiency rejected
category_specific_approval.moat.market_position_or_limited_competit: company_attribution_flag is required for market-leader claims unless relation is sole supplier/single source/only manufacturer/limited qualified competition
category_specific_approval.optionality.new_customer_or_vendor_appro: commercial/customer/vendor relationship must be explicit; customer list alone rejected
category_specific_approval.optionality.new_geography: action_or_status_flag must be true and market/geography entry relation explicit
category_specific_approval.optionality.export_expansion: new/expanded export market/customer/order/action required; static export mix rejected
category_specific_approval.optionality.adjacent_vertical_or_use_cas: specific adjacent/new vertical/segment/use-case deployment relation required

minimum_cohort_policy: If fewer than 30 companies remain ranking-eligible after review, stop the holdout before outcome load. Do not relax review or eligibility rules.
